declarations.description:
Container for displaying a slideshow of content sequentially.

Authors add `webwriter-slide` children; the `type` attribute switches between a thumbnail strip ("slides")
and a tab strip ("tabs"). Thumbnails are drawn in the editor with a capture library that loads on first use.
In use mode the arrow keys, the controls and swipes in fullscreen move between slides. The arrow keys leave
text entry, Alt and Meta combinations alone. Every thumbnail and tab has a button that selects its slide;
in edit mode Space or Enter on the thumbnail itself picks it up for reordering.

The widget follows the page theme: `--ww-text-color`, `--ww-font-family`, and `--ww-theme-accent-1` (the
selected thumbnail or tab). On paper it prints all slides one after another and leaves out the controls.

Conversions: a `section` becomes slides (its nested `section` children become one slide each, otherwise the
section is one slide), and the slides convert to a fragment of `section` elements with the slide content.
The thumbnails are not carried over.

Signals: `slide` is the number of the current slide, starting at 1; `count` is the number of slides.
Both change when readers or authors move to another slide.

Known limitation: in edit mode the drag module sets `touch-action: none` on the thumbnails, so on a touch
screen the thumbnail strip cannot be scrolled by dragging on a thumbnail; the select buttons still work.

members.name: type
members.description:
Defines the type of view for the slideshow.
- "slides": Show content as sequential slides.
- "tabs": Show content using tabs.

members.name: slides
members.description:
All `webwriter-slide` elements.
Represents the individual slides in the slideshow.

members.name: activeSlideIndex
members.description: Index of the currently active slide.

members.name: signals
members.description: Public signals: the current slide number (from 1) and the number of slides.

members.name: actions
members.description: The drawer declarations with the availability of the slide actions, which follows the slides.

members.name: activeSlide
members.description: The active slide element based on the activeSlideIndex.

members.name: hasNextSlide
members.description: False if slideshow is on the last slide.

members.name: hasPreviousSlide
members.description: False if slideshow is on the first slide.

members.name: isFullscreen
members.description: Whether the slideshow is currently displayed in fullscreen mode.

members.name: loadSections
members.description: Replaces the slides with the slides a `section` stands for; declines anything else.

members.name: toSections
members.description: One `section` per slide, in a detached fragment; `null` without slides.

members.name: addSlide
members.description: Add a new empty slide element. Optionally insert after given index.

members.name: duplicateSlide
members.description: Duplicate an existing slide at given index.

members.name: removeActiveSlide
members.description: Remove the currently active slide element.

members.name: removeSlide
members.description: Remove the currently active slide element.

members.name: nextSlide
members.description: Activate the next slide element.

members.name: #handleSelectionChange
members.description: Follows the selection to the slide that contains it.

members.name: #handleKeyDown
members.description:
Handles keyboard navigation for the slideshow.
ArrowRight advances to the next slide, ArrowLeft goes back.
Only possible in preview mode.

members.name: #takesText
members.description: Whether the element is a place where arrow keys move a caret or a value.

members.name: #handleTouchStart
members.description:
Handles the start of a touch event for swipe navigation.
Records the initial touch position and target element.
Only active in fullscreen mode.

members.name: #isInteractiveTarget
members.description:
Determines if the given element or any of its ancestors (up to the slideshow container) is an interactive element.
Used to prevent swipe navigation when interacting with widgets or interactive elements.

members.name: #handleTouchEnd
members.description:
Handles the end of a touch event for swipe navigation.
Determines the swipe direction and navigates to the next or previous slide accordingly.
Ignores swipes on interactive elements or if the swipe distance is too small.

members.name: handleNextSlideClick

parameters.name: e
parameters.description: The triggering mouse or keyboard event.

parameters.name: backwards
parameters.description: Whether to navigate backward (default is false).

members.description:
Handles navigation to the next or previous slide based on user input.
- Shift key: jump by the total number of slides.
- Ctrl key: jump by 10 slides.
- Otherwise: move by one slide.

members.name: changeSlide
members.description:
Changes the active slide to the specified index.
Waits for rendering to finish, scrolls the active slide into view,
and generates a thumbnail preview.

parameters.description: The index of the slide to activate.
parameters.name: index

members.name: onDragCommit
members.description:
Moves the dragged slide to the place the drop resolved to.
The thumbnails and tabs stand for the authored `webwriter-slide` children,
so the commit moves the slide itself and the lifted item settles at the new layout.

members.name: #view
members.description: The slideshow as seen by the strip and control components.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description:
Defines the type of view for the slideshow.
- "slides": Show content as sequential slides.
- "tabs": Show content using tabs.
